title: Choose the elevated hero
question: Same serif type, palette and copy below the fold in all three; only the first screen differs. Pick one, or steer.

options.label: Deep green hero
options.thesis: The first screen is a bottle-green card with ivory engraved type and one ivory Call button.
options.viewport: Header and hero on green; headline, brass rule, Ed's line, ivory CALL ED button with the number. Centered on desktop.
options.risk: Most dramatic of the three; dark first screen is heavier on a phone in bright light.

options.label: Ivory hero, itinerary
options.lineage: first-class boarding pass and travel itinerary
options.thesis: Light first screen; the trip is set as a typeset itinerary: From New Jersey, To Florida, joined by a dotted brass line.
options.viewport: Headline, brass rule, Ed's line, green CALL ED button; the From/To itinerary below it on phones, beside it on desktop.
options.risk: Quietest of the three; elegance rests entirely on type and spacing.

options.label: Ivory hero, fine-line road
options.lineage: today's road drawing, redrawn as a fine-line map
options.thesis: Today's hero kept, restyled: the road from New Jersey down to Florida in a fine stone band with a brass dotted centre line, no car.
options.viewport: Headline, brass rule, Ed's line, green CALL ED button; the road drawing below on phones, to the right on desktop.
options.risk: Closest to the current page; the drawing still reads as illustration rather than luxury.
